item.title: CVE-2026-89324 — Basel Post Types ≤ 1.18 Unauthenticated Auth Bypass via Forged Opauth Callback
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-89324. Status: Weaponized. Affects: Basel Post Types WordPress plugin (basel-post-types), bundled as woodmart-core with the commercial Basel / Woodmart themes by XTemos; requires WooCommerce and a configured social-login provider (Facebook, Google or VKontakte). Tags: authentication-bypass, unauthenticated, WordPress, WooCommerce, Opauth, social-login, hardcoded-secret, admin-takeover, PHP, CWE-287.
